To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we introduce a new class of models of the strongly coupled zig-zig transition; (2) we study the RG flow in these models using both field theory and AdS/CFT calculations; (3) we find a new phase of the zig-zag transition with a new kind of critical behaviour, and a new phase diagram; (4) we find a novel phase transition in the large central limit in which the CFT is driven to zero dimensionality;

(i) the RG flow in the extended model exhibits a new qualitative feature, namely a strongly coupled fixed point with a non-trivial velocity; (ii) the AdS/CFT analysis is non-trivial and requires back-reaction to capture subleading corrections; and (iii) the AdS calculation is a proof-of-principle that the AdS/CMT program can be used to calculate the subleading corrections in the RG flow.

(1) we have proposed a strongly coupled generalization of the zig-zag transition, (2) we have studied the renormalization group flow of this generalization using field theory and AdS/CFT, (3) the generalization has a rich phase diagram with new qualitative features.
